chunks.rationale: Root cause lives here. recordUsage no longer drops all-zero turns (kimi's actual payload), ignores simulate, accumulates cachedInputTokens/cacheWriteTokens, and writes the same numbers into usageThreadsByDay when threadId is set. recordWastedSpend is the subset-not-sum waste ledger: it only bumps wastedUsd, and will mint a turns:0 row if waste arrives before any usage.
risks: A later recordUsage that omits projectId/title overwrites last-seen labels with empty strings. All five live call sites pass them; tests that call recordUsage without labels will wipe them.
recordWastedSpend uses the same (input.model || 'unknown') key as recordUsage. If notifyRunTerminal's model fallback disagrees, waste lands on a phantom provider/model cell.
usageThreadsByDay is created on first write; an older in-memory store that never loaded the contract field is healed, but only on the write path.

chunks.rationale: notifyRunTerminal is the single terminal seam: failed/stopped (not quota-wait) call recordWastedSpend with getUsage(threadId).model || thread.model || 'unknown'. The four provider recordUsage sites now pass thread context; only the claude-stream path (claude/grok) passes cache_read/cache_creation. runUsage.tokensIn is left as the billable number — memory/OTel still treat it that way.
risks: Claude result events can record usage with model:null (→ 'unknown') if system/init never set capturedModel, while waste then falls through to thread.model. Fake tests emit model:'m' so they do not catch this.

Codex reports cached_input_tokens but extractUsage does not surface them, and input_tokens already includes the cache. Passing the cache field through would double-count processed tokens; cache counters stay 0 on purpose.
Call sites that omit extras.costUsd record nothing (0). Generic/text runs never populate waste even when they fail.

chunks.rationale: The fifth recordUsage site. spawnAgentClaude now copies Claude's cache fields into the per-agent usage object; aggCached/aggCacheWrite ride along to the final-phase recordUsage plus thread context. Other spawners have no cache fields, so they add 0.
risks: recordUsage still only fires on final-phase success (pre-existing). A workflow that dies mid-run has spendByDay via per-agent recordSpend and waste via notifyRunTerminal, but no usage-by-day turns for the completed agents.
agent.tokensUsed still sums only input+output; cache is not in that display number.

chunks.rationale: Store-level coverage for the kimi zero-turn, cache split, old-cell coerce, thread rollup + 90-day prune, and waste-without-touching-costUsd. Runner-level coverage drives a fake Claude through startRun for cache passthrough, failed→wastedUsd, and quota-wait→no waste.
risks: The failed/quota tests key on claude.m because the fake emits model:'m' on system/init. A regression that stopped capturing that model would fail these tests for the right reason.
Quota-wait depends on decideQuotaWait parsing the error string; a parser change would make the test park as a real failure and start attributing waste.

Codex cached_input_tokens is inside input_tokens (electron/codex.js:372, :505). The Tokens toggle will show Codex input as the full prompt and cache counters as 0 — correct for this payload, different from Claude's split.
runUsage was not given cache fields. notifyRunTerminal extras.tokensIn and recordRunOutcome stay billable-only.

npm run test:electron: 1507 pass, 7 fail. Known worktree-base failures in checkpoints.test.js and verify-gate.test.js, plus package-app.sh node_modules/ws. Extra flake: memory-sup.test.js 'unregister runs grok mcp remove' waitFor timeout — not on this diff.
Renderer (src/, test/) is owned by the parallel worker; this branch does not render 'unreported' or the project/thread breakdown.
